name: Nebaioth
title: Ishmael's firstborn son
summary: Nebaioth was the firstborn son of Ishmael, Abraham's son through Hagar. He is regarded as the ancestor of an Arab tribe that bears his name. Nebaioth is mentioned in the Bible primarily in genealogies and in connection with prophecies about future blessings.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Nebajoth as Ishmael's firstborn
keyEvents.description: Nebajoth was born as the firstborn son of Ishmael. He is mentioned first in the genealogy of Ishmael's sons.

keyEvents.title: Ishmael's twelve sons as tribal chiefs
keyEvents.description: Nebajoth and his eleven brothers became tribal chiefs and gave their names to their respective tribes and settlements.

keyEvents.title: Esau marries Nebajoth's sister
keyEvents.description: Esau took Bashemath, Ishmael's daughter and Nebajoth's sister, as his wife. This linked Esau's lineage to Ishmael's family.

keyEvents.title: Ishmael's death and Nebajoth's inheritance
keyEvents.description: At Ishmael's death at the age of 137, Nebajoth and his brothers took over leadership of the tribes. They settled from Havilah to Shur.

keyEvents.title: Nebajoth's lineage mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Nebajot is mentioned again in First Chronicles as part of Ishmael's genealogy, confirming his place in Israel's broader family history.

keyEvents.title: The Prophecy about Nebajot's Flocks
keyEvents.description: Isaiah prophesies that the sheep of Kedar and Nebajot will serve God and come up to the altar as pleasing offerings in the messianic future.
